messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: p99 latency > 1.2s for route /v1/generate (eu-west). PD INC-2026. Automatic page to @eng-oncall.
oliver: acked. I’m oncall — landing in the thread.
maria: on it — pulling up grafana and traces now. any customer reports?
alex: seeing broad tail. p95 ~450ms (baseline ~150ms), p99 ~1.3s (baseline ~300ms). kvcache miss rate spiked ~x6. sidecar queue depth climbed.
sam: frontend is mostly 200s still, a handful of timeouts in traces. not many 500s.
maria: looks like a kvcache hotkey + a burst of long contexts. trying prefix eviction and warming. running: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/evict-cache -d '{"prefix":"user:recent:*"}'`
oliver: started a scale up for eu-dedicated pool: `POST /ops/scale {"pool":"eu-dedicated","delta":2}` — already in flight.
alex: also toggled batching hint to smaller windows for this route to reduce head-of-line. patch applied to canary.
tess: support: no customer tickets so far. monitoring NRT for mentions. if we hit degraded error rate >0.5% we’ll page customers.
maria: p99 trending down to ~820ms after eviction + scale. still above SLO. can we route low-priority traffic to fallback model to keep SLO for premium traffic?
oliver: enabling fallback route policy for eu-west low-prio traffic now: `cfg route set /v1/generate fallback=stable-quantized` — done.
sam: confirming no backlog on stable-quantized. latency there is ~300ms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026 acknowledged by oliver.
maria: mitigation in flight. metrics: p99 1.3s -> 820ms -> 610ms over 8m. kvcache miss rate falling.
alex: next steps: 1) postmortem if we cross 15m SLO burn, 2) add automatic eviction rule for prefix when miss rate spike detected, 3) revisit batching heuristics.
oliver: I’ll stay on for 30m and then hand off to night oncall if stable. tagging @maria for followup playbook items. :thumbsup:
tess: support will prepare a short status note if we see any customer tickets.
maria: thanks team — update again in 10m or earlier if regression.
summary: Automated PagerDuty page for high p99 latency in eu-west. Team acked, evicted hot KV prefixes, scaled dedicated pool, temporarily routed low-priority traffic to fallback model. p99 decreased but still above SLO; monitoring and follow-up actions planned.
